# Draft:Driving Empire

Driving Empire (formerly known as Wayfort) is a Roblox driving simulation experience created by Bourgist on June 2019 and later partnered with Voldex Games on December 22, 2022. The map of the game is a fictional city called Wayfort, which is based on California.
Experience
Driving Empire is focused on car driving and racing, players can choose from over 170 cars. The game have 4 types of vehicles including cars, motorcycles, boats and aircrafts. From November 2023, Voldex started to add licensed brands and cars into the game. As of the time writing, Apollo, Audi, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Corvette, De Tomaso, Devel, Gordon Murray, Hennessey, Jaguar, KTM, Lamborghini, Land Rover, Lotus, McLaren, Nobel, Pagani, Porsche, TVR, W Motors, and Zenvo are licensed. Players can race with friends, collect their beloved cars, and customize their cars. Players can earn in game cash by racing, competing quests and even by just driving around.
Vehicles
In the 170+ vehicles, almost all of them fall under the cars category. There is a very wide range of vehicles, even though most of the cars are sports cars, there are sedans, SUVs, and pickup trucks as well. In the dealership, players can view all the vehicles of the category and sort them by top speed, handling, price, and body customization. The are collections of some brand and there are rewards like cash boost and collection car for completing the collection.
Licensed Vehicles
Licensed vehicles are a big part in Driving Empire, as Voldex wants a full licensed game. There are many licensed vehicles in the game and players enjoy having them very much, as the chance of vehicles removal cause by copyrights in gone. The models are also more detailed after licensing and the brand logos can be shown.
Unlicensed Vehicles
Most unlicensed vehicles visible in the dealership left are knock-off models, the unlicensed models of in real life cars are all hidden from the dealership to prevent copyright issues. When Voldex add in licensed vehicles, the old unlicensed models will be converted or deleted.
Gameplay
Players will start with $15 000 cash and a choice of 3 starter cars, they can gain money by driving, racing, doing quests, watching ads, and now even by afking. Players can play to get enough cash to buy the cars they want. Once a while there will be limited cars on sale for a week or two and players can collect these cars.
Customizing
The customizing system combines old version of an upgradeable set-up, which unlocks slots for upgrade cards obtained from tuning kits. A tuning kit cost $20k and gives 5 random cars of different parts and rarity. Cards can be fused together to improve level and power, and equipped on cars to improve performance.
